about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Passionate about building meaningful digital solutions
about.body1: I'm Abd El Rahman, a Software Engineer and Mobile Application Developer with a Bachelor's Degree in Communication Technology and a passion for creating meaningful digital solutions.
about.body2: My work combines software engineering, creative problem-solving, and a strong understanding of practical business needs. I develop mobile applications, business management systems, educational platforms, invoicing solutions, and customized software for individuals, startups, companies, factories, and retail businesses.
about.body3: In addition to development, I provide online and offline programming and AI training, support graduation projects, and help clients turn their ideas into functional digital products.
about.body4: Whether you need a mobile application, a custom business system, technical guidance, or assistance launching your app on Google Play, I focus on delivering practical solutions with attention to quality, usability, and professional execution.
